title: AAPS stopped receiving BG data from BYODA
symptom: AAPS stopped receiving any BG data from BYODA, displaying old readings with (180 mins ago) and then n/a after reinstallation. The app is crashing regularly, possibly when trying to receive a reading from BYODA. BYODA itself is working fine.
fix: Reinstalling BYODA resolved the issue. The user also updated NS version, but it was determined that NS version was not the cause.
evidence_quote: I reinstalled BYODA and that seemed to resolve it.
